recommended_approach: VULCAN-2D v0.2 = "MF-K-Weibull" — a mean-field areal soft-breakdown core (Approach 2 spine) carrying a SMALL number K of spatial sub-population fields phi_k(t) over the device area, with WEIBULL per-site SET/RESET threshold fields (grafted from DDPN/Approach 4), area-summed trap-assisted-tunnelling (TAT) conduction with a closed-form GEM/Bruggeman percolation factor on the SET knee (optional, from Approach 1), two INDEPENDENT activation-energy/threshold draws for SET vs RESET (from PTE/Approach 3), and a series-MOSFET load-line cap solved per step. The endorsed top pick across all three judges is Approach 2; I build it as the spine and graft exactly the four things the judges endorsed. CRITICAL HONESTY FIX (mandated by all three judges and independently re-verified by me in this session: order-statistic threshold-crossing self-averages from 5.4% CV at N=50 to 1.2% at N=1000, NOT 25%): the cycle-to-cycle (C2C) switching-voltage spread is NOT claimed emergent from finite-N counting. It is generated by a per-cycle stochastic EFFECTIVE-BARRIER fluctuation (a single global threshold draw per half-loop, amplitude set by configurational disorder of the few dominant weak-link sites over the tiny area), which does NOT self-average because it is one collective threshold, not a sum over N. Its width is an explicit CALIBRATED knob. What IS labelled genuinely emergent: (i) I_cc CV~1% (R2) from structural transistor decoupling; (ii) lognormal-R SHAPE (R4) from multiplicative residual-site conduction through the reciprocal divider; (iii) V_set/V_reset INDEPENDENCE (R4, corr~0) from disjoint SET/RESET random draws on opposite kinetic branches; (iv) progressive transitions (R1) from the K-population barrier CDF; (v) the memory window and HRS/LRS magnitudes. USE THE SERIES-DIVIDER TRANSISTOR SET (vulcan_calibrated.npz: Isat_set=0.37uA/Vk=0.759/lam=27.4 -> R_LRS@0.2V=324kOhm matching measured 290kOhm; Isat_reset=29.4nA/0.355/119.2 -> erase plateau 0.4uA matching measured 0.385uA), NOT the M2 branch-shape set (22.3uA/1.77/0.26 -> 76kOhm, 4x off). Both hit I_cc=51uA at apex; only the 0.2V read distinguishes them.
rationale: Three independent adversarial judges all converged on Approach 2 (MF-phi) as the spine for three reasons I verified against the repo: (1) its exponential-Euler exact-per-frozen-coefficient update phi<-phi*exp(-b*dt)+(a/b)(1-exp(-b*dt)) on the linear-in-phi kinetics dphi/dt=a-b*phi is unconditionally stable and bounded in [0,1] for any b*dt, eliminating v0.1's clip hack and the percolation-stiffness/19-decade-divider fragility that sank Approach 1; (2) it is the most parsimonious (~18 params) and the ONLY proposal honest about which variability is tuned vs emergent; (3) its per-cycle stochastic channel is the only one physically legitimate for a SINGLE measured cell (the 53 sweeps are ONE device, so any per-site quenched disorder is FROZEN and produces only device-to-device spread, NOT the observed cycle-to-cycle spread — the fatal flaw all three site-ensemble proposals leaned on). I independently re-ran the finite-N order-statistic test this session and reproduced the judges' numbers exactly (CV 5.4%/2.2%/1.2% at N=50/300/1000), proving finite-N counting cannot deliver 25%. I grafted Weibull thresholds (DDPN) because Weibull is the textbook native-defect dielectric-breakdown statistic and gives a clean mean-Vset/CV-Vset handle; the two-independent-array structure (PTE) because it makes corr(V_set,V_reset)~0 a genuine structural emergence (I verified corr=-0.04 in data, reproduced -0.12 at n=53 sampling noise); and a closed-form Bruggeman factor (Percolation-KMC) ONLY as an optional knee-sharpener, kept as closed-form G_eff(phi) never a Kirchhoff solve. The transistor-set correction is load-bearing and I verified the arithmetic numerically: series set gives R_LRS=3.24e5 Ohm (data 2.94e5), branch set gives 7.59e4 (4x off); both give I_cc=5.11e-5 at apex. I also re-derived the lognormal-R emergence: a per-cycle multiplicative residual-conduction factor through R=1/(G_eff*alpha) gives Shapiro p(logR)=0.56 with sigma_lnR=0.51, matching measured 0.521.
state_variables:
PRIMARY DYNAMICAL STATE (integrated in time, per device instance):
  phi : float64 array, shape (n_dev, K). The mean-field soft-breakdown fraction of each of K spatial sub-populations (areal patches) of the device. K=6 (range 4-8). phi_k in [0,1]: 0=pristine HRS patch (residual TAT only), 1=fully soft-broken LRS patch. Device mean field phibar = sum_k w_k*phi_k (scalar per device).
  D : float64 array, shape (n_dev,). Slow irreversible damage accumulator (dimensionless), one scalar per device, integrating cumulative |dphi| across all 53 cycles. Drives endurance drift R5. Persists across cycles; phi is reset toward floor each cycle by the RESET sweep (not hand-reset).

STATIC PER-INSTANCE QUENCHED DISORDER (drawn ONCE per device at creation, frozen across all 53 cycles -> this is the DEVICE-TO-DEVICE / D2D channel, and the source of lognormal-R WIDTH):
  w : float64 array, shape (n_dev, K). Patch area weights, Dirichlet(conc=0.6) so sum_k w_k=1 with a few dominant patches (the weak links). Frozen.
  ln_g_site : float64 array, shape (n_dev, K). Per-patch log-conductance offset ~ N(0, sigma_lnG), the multiplicative residual that makes R lognormal. Frozen. sigma_lnG is the CALIBRATED knob for sigma_lnR_HRS=0.52.
  Isat_inst : float64 array, shape (n_dev,). Per-device transistor saturation-current multiplier ~ N(1, icc_noise=0.01). Frozen. Sole source of I_cc CV.

PER-CYCLE STOCHASTIC THRESHOLD STATE (re-drawn EACH cycle, EACH half-loop -> this is the legitimate CYCLE-TO-CYCLE / C2C channel; the ONE place 25% CV enters, honestly calibrated, NOT emergent from finite-N):
  Eth_set_c  : float64 array, shape (n_dev,). Per-cycle effective SET-threshold field ~ Weibull(eta_set, m_set), independent draw. Sets V_set this cycle.
  Eth_rst_c  : float64 array, shape (n_dev,). Per-cycle effective RESET-threshold field ~ Weibull(eta_rst, m_rst), INDEPENDENT draw from Eth_set_c. Sets V_reset this cycle. Independence -> corr(V_set,V_reset)~0.
  rho_carry  : float64 array, shape (n_dev,). Fraction of previous-cycle residual phi carried into this cycle's threshold (gives the +0.2 lag-1 ACF, R4).

AUXILIARY (recomputed each voltage step, NOT integrated, no persistent storage):
  V_h : voltage across h-BN after the series divider [V]; V_tr = V_app - V_h [V]; I_dev [A]; T : lumped node temperature [K].

SIZES: for n_dev devices and K=6, persistent state is n_dev*(K + K + K + 1 + 4) ~ n_dev*23 float64. For a 1-device 53-cycle run that is ~23 floats; for a 200-device D2D ensemble ~4600 floats. Trivial memory. The heavy compute is the (n_dev, K) array updated over ~676 voltage steps x 53 cycles, fully vectorized.

equations.name: Per-patch TAT conduction (odd, symmetric, matches HRS sinh fit)
equations.formula: i_k(V_h) = w_k * g0 * exp(ln_g_site_k) * [1 + (Gon-1)*Theta(phi_k)] * sinh(alpha * clip(V_h, -Vclip, Vclip))
equations.symbols_units: i_k [A] patch current; w_k [-] area weight; g0=alpha*I_s=6.747*6.224e-10=4.20e-9 [A] pristine ensemble scale (so sum_k w_k*g0*sinh gives I_s*sinh, I_s=6.224e-10 A); ln_g_site_k [-] frozen log-conductance offset; Gon [-] full-LRS conductance lift per patch (~600-1000); alpha=6.747 [1/V] FIXED from HRS fit; Vclip=5.8 V so alpha*Vclip~39 prevents sinh overflow (unclipped sinh(6.75*5)=2.27e14)

equations.name: GEM/Bruggeman percolation knee factor (optional sharpener; default linear = set p_perc->1)
equations.formula: Theta(phi) = clip((phi - phic)/(1 - phic), 0, 1)**t  for phi>phic ; else eps0*(phi/phic)**q
equations.symbols_units: Theta [-] in [0,1]; phic=0.30 [-] 2D-lattice threshold (FIXED, literature); t=1.3 [-] 2D conductivity exponent; q=1, eps0~3e-3 sub-threshold floor. DEFAULT linear mode Theta(phi)=phi (set p_perc=0) unless area-scaling data justifies percolation. Closed-form ONLY, never a Kirchhoff solve.

equations.name: Total h-BN (memristor) branch current = area sum
equations.formula: I_hBN(V_h, phi) = g0 * sinh(alpha*clip(V_h)) * sum_k w_k*exp(ln_g_site_k)*[1 + (Gon-1)*Theta(phi_k)] = G_ens(phi) * sinh(alpha*clip(V_h))
equations.symbols_units: G_ens(phi) [A] lumped ensemble prefactor. HRS (all phi_k~0): G_ens->g0*sum_k w_k*exp(ln_g_site_k) -> sets R_HRS lognormal. LRS (phi_k->1): G_ens->g0*Gon -> backbone near-metallic.

equations.name: Series MOSFET output branch (write/erase polarity-selected; SERIES-DIVIDER set)
equations.formula: I_tr(V_tr; side) = Isat_inst * Isat(side) * (1 + lam(side)*|V_tr|) * tanh(|V_tr|/Vk(side)) * sign(V_tr)
equations.symbols_units: WRITE/SET side: Isat=0.37e-6 A, Vk=0.759 V, lam=27.4 /V. ERASE/RESET side: Isat=29.4e-9 A, Vk=0.355 V, lam=119.2 /V. (USE THESE, not 22.3uA/1.77/0.26.) Isat_inst~N(1,0.01) per device -> I_cc CV~1%.

equations.name: Series load-line divider (the cap; solved per step)
equations.formula: Find V_h in [0,|V_app|] s.t. I_hBN(V_h,phi) - I_tr(V_app - V_h; side) = 0 ; then I_dev = I_hBN(V_h,phi)
equations.symbols_units: V_app [V] terminal sweep voltage; V_h [V] h-BN drop; V_tr=V_app-V_h [V] transistor drop. Both branches monotone in V_h -> bracketed Brent/Newton, 6-10 evals. HRS: I_hBN<<I_tr so V_h~V_app, h-BN-limited (sinh HRS). LRS: I_hBN>>I_tr so V_tr carries drop, I_dev->Isat=I_cc. Warm-start: bottleneck blend 1/I=1/I_hBN+1/I_tr (closed form) for inner sweep, exact Brent only at read 0.2V and apex 5V.

equations.name: Mean-field kinetics per sub-population (linear in phi_k -> exact exponential-Euler)
equations.formula: dphi_k/dt = G_k*(1-phi_k) - R_k*(phi_k - phi_floor) = a_k - b_k*phi_k ; a_k=G_k+R_k*phi_floor, b_k=G_k+R_k
equations.symbols_units: phi_floor=0..0.02 residual; G_k generation (SET) rate [1/s], R_k recovery (RESET) rate [1/s] below.

equations.name: Generation / recovery rates (Weibull-gated, Arrhenius-thermal, odd in field)
equations.formula: G_k = nu0_set*exp(-Ea_set/(kB*T)) * relu(sinh(beta_set*(|E_h| - Eth_set_c)))  for V_h>0 else 0 ;  R_k = nu0_rst*exp(-Ea_rst/(kB*T)) * relu(sinh(beta_rst*(|E_h| - Eth_rst_c)))  for V_h<0 else 0
equations.symbols_units: E_h = V_h/(Leff*d_layer) per-layer field [V/nm]; d_layer=0.33 nm, Leff~18 (or absorb to 1, recalibrate alpha). Eth_set_c/Eth_rst_c [V/nm] per-cycle Weibull thresholds (the C2C knob). nu0_set=1.19e14, nu0_rst=2.32e14 [1/s] (from v0.1, calibrated to V_set/V_reset means); ratio + Ea_rst<Ea_set fixes t_SET/t_RESET~296. Ea_set=1.00, Ea_rst~0.92 eV. beta_set=3.0, beta_rst=4.0 [nm/V]. kB=8.617e-5 eV/K. At V=0 both rates ~0 -> non-volatile retention.

equations.name: Exact exponential-Euler update (unconditionally stable, keeps phi in [0,1])
equations.formula: phi_k <- phi_k*exp(-b_k*dt) + (a_k/b_k)*(1 - exp(-b_k*dt)) ; then add C2C-already-in-threshold; clip(phi_k, phi_floor, 1)
equations.symbols_units: dt [s] dwell time per voltage step (real time, NOT merged nu0*dt). Stable for any b_k*dt incl. 1e6 (verified by judges). No noise term added to phi (the C2C noise lives in the per-cycle Eth draw, the legitimate channel).

equations.name: Lumped electro-thermal feedback (transport->kinetics)
equations.symbols_units: T0=300 K, Rth=3e5 K/W (carry-over, refine with variable-T data), Tmax=1500 K. Uses V_h (h-BN dissipation), not V_app (transistor dissipates on-chip). Feeds every G_k,R_k via Arrhenius -> positive feedback sharpens SET while K-spread keeps it progressive.

equations.name: Endurance damage law (R5)
equations.formula: D <- D + kappa_dmg * sum_k w_k*|dphi_k| (per cycle) ; Eth_set_c_mean += cE*D ; phi_floor += cf*D
equations.symbols_units: kappa_dmg, cE [V/nm per D], cf [-]: cE*kappa_dmg -> V_set +8.5 mV/cycle; cf*kappa_dmg -> R_HRS down (floor up), R_LRS up. V_reset has NO damage coupling -> no drift, matching data.

equations.name: Read-resistance estimator (emergent feature, matches data extractor)
equations.formula: R_HRS = 0.2/I_dev(0.2 on SET upsweep, pristine) ; R_LRS = 0.2/I_dev(0.2 on SET return, switched) ; I_cc = I_dev at +5V apex ; V_set = first V where phibar crosses 0.5 (SET up) ; V_reset = first V where phibar crosses 0.5 (RESET down)
equations.symbols_units: R [Ohm], I [A], V [V]. Reuse the exact 0.2V-read and apex logic from analysis/extract_features.py so model and data go through identical estimators.

regularity_emergence.regularity: R1 bipolar switching + hysteresis + PROGRESSIVE (gradual) transitions
regularity_emergence.mechanism: Kinetics are polarity-gated and odd in field: G_k active only for V_h>0 (SET, phi up), R_k active only for V_h<0 (RESET, phi down). phibar is non-volatile at V=0 (both rates ~0) so the return sweep keeps the forward-set state -> hysteresis loop. PROGRESSIVE: the K sub-populations have a SPREAD of Weibull thresholds Eth_k, so patches soft-break sequentially over a voltage window -> G_ens(phi) rises as a smooth sigmoid (an integral over the threshold CDF), reproducing the 'progressive state transitions' the Nature paper cites as the non-filamentary diagnostic. Optional Theta(phi) Bruggeman factor can sharpen the knee without making it discontinuous. EMERGENT (structural).

regularity_emergence.regularity: R2 I_cc=5.146e-5 A CV 1.0% (near-deterministic) while V/R vary 24-46% (THE 1T1M signature)
regularity_emergence.mechanism: GENUINELY EMERGENT and the cleanest emergence in the model. In LRS phibar->1 so G_ens is large and I_hBN>>I_tr; the load-line divider forces almost all apex voltage onto the transistor, so I_dev -> Isat(write)*Isat_inst*(1+lam*5)*tanh(5/Vk) = I_cc, set ONLY by the gate-fixed Isat. Isat is a TRANSISTOR parameter, structurally DECOUPLED from the random defect ensemble (phi, ln_g_site, Eth), so its only spread is Isat_inst~N(1,0.01) -> CV(I_cc)~1%. The switching voltages/resistances stay at full 24-46% because they are set BELOW compliance by the random Eth/ln_g_site. I verified the divider gives I_cc=5.106e-5 at apex with the series set. The 1%-vs-25% split is structural, not fitted.

R_HRS = 1/(G_ens(phi~0)*alpha) = 1/(g0*sum_k w_k*exp(ln_g_site_k)*alpha); with g0=4.20e-9 the median gives 1/(4.2e-9*6.747)=3.5e7 base, tuned via g0 and the residual floor to median 2.0e8 Ohm. R_LRS@0.2V is TRANSISTOR-limited = 0.2/I_tr(0.2;write) = 3.24e5 Ohm (I verified with the SERIES set; the branch set gives 7.6e4, wrong). Window = R_HRS/R_LRS ~ 600x falls out of (HRS h-BN floor)/(transistor R_on), set by Gon (patch lift) and the transistor R_on=Vk/Isat. EMERGENT given calibrated g0, Gon, transistor set.

regularity_emergence.regularity: R4a R_HRS/R_LRS LOGNORMAL (sigma_lnR_HRS=0.521) — SHAPE emergent, WIDTH calibrated
regularity_emergence.mechanism: SHAPE is GENUINELY EMERGENT: R = 1/(alpha*G_ens), G_ens = g0*sum_k w_k*exp(ln_g_site_k)*[...]. The frozen multiplicative residual exp(ln_g_site_k) over the few dominant weak-link patches makes R a reciprocal of a product-of-lognormals -> R is lognormal by the multiplicative CLT. I verified: a per-cycle multiplicative residual through R=1/(G*alpha) gives Shapiro p(logR)=0.56, sigma_lnR=0.51 vs measured 0.521. WIDTH (sigma_lnR=0.52) is an HONESTLY CALIBRATED knob sigma_lnG, NOT claimed emergent — the judges proved area-summing SHRINKS sigma_lnR by ~sqrt(N), so the width must be injected via per-site spread. We label SHAPE emergent, WIDTH tuned.

regularity_emergence.regularity: R4b V_set=1.30 CV25% & V_reset=-1.07 CV24% NORMAL; INDEPENDENT (corr~0); +0.2 lag-1 ACF
regularity_emergence.mechanism: INDEPENDENCE is GENUINELY EMERGENT (structural): Eth_set_c and Eth_rst_c are drawn INDEPENDENTLY each cycle from separate Weibull(eta_set,m_set) and Weibull(eta_rst,m_rst) on disjoint kinetic branches -> corr(V_set,V_reset)~0 with NO imposed correlation (I verified data corr=-0.04, model -0.12 at n=53 noise). NORMAL SHAPE: with Weibull shape m~4 the threshold distribution is near-Gaussian over the relevant range. CV 25%/24% is the CALIBRATED C2C knob (eta/m spread) — HONESTLY NOT emergent from finite-N (re-verified this session: finite-N order statistic gives only 1.2-5.4% CV, self-averaging). The per-cycle global-barrier fluctuation does NOT self-average because it is one collective threshold over the few dominant weak-link patches, not a sum over N. ACF +0.2 (measured Vset 0.213, Vreset 0.293) EMERGES from rho_carry: residual phi not fully reset carries a fraction into next cycle's effective threshold.

regularity_emergence.regularity: R5 endurance drift over 53 cycles: V_set +8.5 mV/cycle, R_HRS down, R_LRS up, window narrows
regularity_emergence.mechanism: Damage accumulator D += kappa_dmg*sum_k w_k*|dphi_k| each cycle (irreversible defect generation). D drifts the SET threshold mean up (cE*D) -> V_set +8.5 mV/cycle (Kendall tau=+0.44 target); raises phi_floor (cf*D) -> residual conduction up -> R_HRS down, degraded backbone -> R_LRS up -> window narrows. V_reset threshold has NO damage coupling -> no drift, matching data (V_reset shows no significant trend). Phenomenological accumulator (honest limitation), calibrated last to the 53-cycle slopes.

regularity_emergence.regularity: R6 write-side LRS (22-50 uA) vs erase-side LRS plateau (~0.4 uA)
regularity_emergence.mechanism: Pure transistor-branch property: SET uses (Isat,Vk,lam)_write=(0.37uA,0.759,27.4), RESET uses (Isat,Vk,lam)_erase=(29.4nA,0.355,119.2). Erase plateau = I_tr(~1V;erase)=3.5e-7 A ~ measured 3.85e-7 A (NOT the 1-2uA repeated in proposals; I verified). The h-BN ensemble G_ens (and HRS) is IDENTICAL both polarities, so HRS is bias-independent (matches data R0~2e8 both sides) while only the transistor-limited LRS plateau differs. EMERGENT given two polarity-selected parameter sets (hand-selected but physically correct: gate fixes compliance).

calibration_steps: STEP 0 (FIX transport): alpha=6.747 from HRS sinh fit (analysis/conduction_models.py, R2_log=0.998); g0=alpha*I_s=4.20e-9 with I_s=6.224e-10 from model_params.npz['Gh']. These are FIXED, never refit.
STEP 1 (R_HRS scale): tune g0 base + phi_floor so median R_HRS(0)=1/(I_s*alpha) lands on measured median 2.045e8 Ohm. One scalar match.

STEP 2 (TRANSISTOR — USE SERIES SET): set write (Isat=0.37uA,Vk=0.759,lam=27.4) and erase (Isat=29.4nA,Vk=0.355,lam=119.2) from vulcan_calibrated.npz. VERIFY by arithmetic: I_tr(0.2;write)=6.18e-7 -> R_LRS@0.2V=3.24e5 Ohm (target 2.94e5), I_tr(5;write)=5.11e-5 (target I_cc 5.146e-5), I_tr(~1;erase)=3.5e-7 (target erase plateau 3.85e-7). DO NOT use the 22.3uA/1.77/0.26 branch-shape set (gives 7.6e4, 4x off).
STEP 3 (Gon / window): set Gon (patch conductance lift) so fully-switched G_ens lifts R_HRS/R_LRS to ~600x given STEP1 (R_HRS) and STEP2 (transistor R_on). Closed-form, monotone in Gon.
STEP 4 (I_cc CV): set icc_noise=0.01 (Isat_inst~N(1,0.01)). Run apex divider over n_dev; VERIFY emergent CV(I_cc)=1.0% (this is the structural decoupling — confirm it, do not tune V/R to it).

STEP 5 (SET threshold mean+CV): bisection-calibrate eta_set (mean V_set=1.298) then m_set (or eta spread) so per-cycle Weibull gives emergent CV(V_set)=25.2%. STATE HONESTLY: this CV is a calibrated C2C input, NOT emergent from finite-N (verified: finite-N gives only 1-5%).

STEP 6 (RESET threshold mean+CV, INDEPENDENT): bisection-calibrate eta_rst (mean V_reset=-1.075) then m_rst so CV(V_reset)=24.3%, drawn INDEPENDENTLY of SET. VERIFY emergent corr(V_set,V_reset)~0 (genuine structural emergence) and near-Normal shape (Shapiro).
STEP 7 (lognormal-R width): set sigma_lnG so emergent sigma_lnR_HRS=0.521 and sigma_lnR_LRS~0.285. VERIFY shape via Shapiro on log(R) (shape emergent, width tuned).

STEP 8 (kinetic time asymmetry): set nu0_rst/nu0_set ratio (~2x) and Ea_rst<Ea_set so a constant-stress pulse gives t_SET=232us, t_RESET=783ns (~296x). For quasi-static sweeps the nu0*dt product is what matters; cross-check it still hits the STEP5/6 means. Carry nu0_set=1.19e14, nu0_rst=2.32e14 from v0.1.
STEP 9 (lag-1 ACF): set rho_carry=0.2 so emergent lag-1 ACF(V_set)=+0.21, ACF(V_reset)=+0.29.
STEP 10 (thermal): set Rth=3e5 K/W, Tmax=1500 K as documented assumptions (no variable-T data); refine only with temperature-dependent I-V.
STEP 11 (endurance, LAST, on the 53-cycle sequence): fit kappa_dmg, cE, cf to V_set +8.5 mV/cycle (Kendall tau=+0.44), R_HRS tau=-0.28, R_LRS tau=+0.27.

STEP 12 (VALIDATION, nothing fitted here): run 53-cycle MC; confirm memory window ~600x, V_set/V_reset Normal+independent, R lognormal SHAPE, I_cc CV~1%, drift slopes — all within n=53 sampling noise of the measured cloud. Also run the N=1 / K=1 deterministic limit and confirm it reduces to the v0.1 mean-field curve (continuity gate).
numerics:
INTEGRATION: per voltage step, (1) solve the series load-line for V_h: warm-start with the closed-form bottleneck blend 1/I=1/I_hBN+1/I_tr, then 2-3 vectorized Newton steps on f(V_h)=I_hBN(V_h,phi)-I_tr(V_app-V_h); use scipy.optimize.brentq (bracket [0,|V_app|], guaranteed sign change since both branches monotone) ONLY at the read point (0.2V) and apex (5V) where accuracy matters, blend for the rest. (2) T=min(T0+Rth*|I_dev*V_h|,Tmax). (3) compute G_k,R_k (vectorized exp over (n_dev,K)) and apply the EXACT exponential-Euler update phi<-phi*exp(-b*dt)+(a/b)*(1-exp(-b*dt)) — unconditionally stable and bounded in [0,1] for any b*dt (verified to 1e6 by judges), removing v0.1's clip hack entirely. clip(phi,phi_floor,1) as a cheap safety net only.

VECTORIZATION: state is an (n_dev, K) float64 array. The ONLY Python loop is over voltage steps (~503 SET + 173 RESET = 676/cycle) and cycles (53). All per-step ops are numpy broadcasts over (n_dev,K). The C2C threshold draws Eth_set_c/Eth_rst_c are (n_dev,) Weibull samples per cycle. Stack the 53 cycles by re-using the same (n_dev,K) arrays and integrating the damage D between cycles. Optionally batch ALL n_dev devices as the leading axis so a 200-device D2D ensemble is one set of broadcast ops.

STABILITY SAFEGUARDS: (a) clip(alpha*V_h, -39, 39) and clip(beta*E,-39,39) to prevent sinh overflow (unclipped sinh(6.75*5)=2.27e14, I_hBN=1.4e5 A — MUST clip). (b) exponential-Euler guarantees phi bounded; no per-step dphi clamp needed. (c) brentq bracketed -> never fails; Newton warm-started by monotone blend -> globally convergent. (d) Tmax clamp prevents thermal runaway. (e) seeded numpy Generator per device for reproducible D2D.

COST: 1 device x 53 cycles x 676 steps x (K=6 vector update + ~5 divider evals) ~ 2e5 vector ops on length-6 arrays + ~6 brentq calls/cycle. v0.1 (same structure, K=1) imports and runs a 53-cycle MC in well under 1 s. v0.2 with K=6: a single-cell 53-cycle MC in ~0.5-2 s; a 200-device D2D+C2C ensemble (200x53 cycles, batched) in seconds to ~1 minute in pure numpy/scipy. Feature extraction (V_set, V_reset, R_HRS, R_LRS, I_cc) reuses the exact 0.2V-read/apex/phibar-crossing logic from analysis/extract_features.py so model and data go through identical estimators.

file_plan.contents: Package init. Exports Params, DeviceEnsemble, simulate_cycles, extract_features. Single source of physical constants (kB=8.617e-5 eV/K).

@dataclass Params with ALL calibrated values from this design (alpha=6.747, I_s=6.224e-10, g0=4.20e-9, K=6, Gon, sigma_lnG=0.52, transistor SERIES set Isat_set=0.37e-6/Vk_set=0.759/lam_set=27.4 and Isat_reset=29.4e-9/Vk_reset=0.355/lam_reset=119.2, icc_noise=0.01, eta_set/m_set, eta_rst/m_rst, nu0_set=1.19e14/nu0_rst=2.32e14, Ea_set=1.0/Ea_rst=0.92, beta_set=3/beta_rst=4, d_layer=0.33/Leff=18, Rth=3e5/Tmax=1500/T0=300, rho_carry=0.2, kappa_dmg/cE/cf, phic=0.30/t=1.3/q=1/eps0=3e-3/p_perc=0). load_from_npz() to read analysis/vulcan_calibrated.npz.

i_hBN(V_h, phi, dev): area-summed TAT G_ens(phi)*sinh(clip(alpha*V_h,-39,39)) with Theta(phi) Bruggeman knee (p_perc switch). i_tr(V_tr, side, dev): MOSFET tanh branch, polarity-selected SERIES set, Isat_inst per device. theta_gem(phi): closed-form Bruggeman. divider_solve(V_app, phi, side, dev): bottleneck-blend warm start + 2-3 vectorized Newton; brentq fallback flag for read/apex. Returns I_dev, V_h, V_tr.

rates(V_h, T, phi, Eth_set_c, Eth_rst_c, dev): vectorized G_k,R_k with Weibull-gated relu(sinh(beta*(|E|-Eth))) and Arrhenius. step_phi(phi, G, R, dt, phi_floor): EXACT exponential-Euler phi*exp(-b*dt)+(a/b)*(1-exp(-b*dt)). thermal(I_dev,V_h): lumped T clamp.

make_devices(n_dev, p, rng): draw FROZEN w[Dirichlet], ln_g_site[N(0,sigma_lnG)], Isat_inst[N(1,icc_noise)]. draw_cycle_thresholds(n_dev,p,rng): per-cycle INDEPENDENT Eth_set_c~Weibull(eta_set,m_set), Eth_rst_c~Weibull(eta_rst,m_rst). Returns a DeviceEnsemble dataclass holding frozen + per-cycle state + D accumulator.

triangle(vpeak,step=0.02,dt): build SET (0->+5->0, 503 pts) and RESET (0->-1.7->0, 173 pts) waveforms with real dt. run_sweep(Vwave, dev, side, p): vectorized voltage-step loop calling divider_solve/rates/step_phi, records I_dev, phibar, T. simulate_cycle(dev,p,rng): SET then RESET, applies rho_carry residual + D damage. simulate_cycles(n_dev, n_cycles=53, p, seed): full MC, returns I-V arrays + per-cycle phibar trajectories.

extract_features(Vw,Iw,phibar): V_set/V_reset from phibar crossing 0.5, R_HRS/R_LRS=0.2/I at 0.2V (pristine vs return), I_cc at apex. MIRRORS analysis/extract_features.py EXACTLY so model and data use identical estimators. summary_stats(feats): means, CV, sigma_lnR, corr, lag-1 ACF, Kendall tau.

Ordered calibration driver implementing STEPS 0-11: load data via pandas.read_excel(both xlsx, sheet_name=None); fix alpha/g0; set transistor SERIES set + VERIFY arithmetic; bisection on eta_set/eta_rst for V_set/V_reset means; tune m/spread for CV; tune sigma_lnG for sigma_lnR; tune rho_carry for ACF; fit kappa_dmg/cE/cf for drift. Writes vulcan2d_calibrated.npz.

Validation driver: run 53-cycle MC, run extract_features on data (the two xlsx) and on model, side-by-side table of all targets, Shapiro tests, KS/overlap of I-V clouds, N=1 reduction-to-v0.1 continuity check. Emits validation_report figures + pass/fail per checklist item.

Doc: physics, the C2C-vs-D2D honesty note (25% CV is calibrated not emergent; what IS emergent: I_cc CV, lognormal shape, independence, progressive transitions), transistor-set warning (use series set), run instructions.

validation_checklist: V_set mean = 1.298 V (data) within n=53 sampling noise; CV(V_set) = 25.2% (calibrated, confirm hit)
corr(V_set, V_reset) within +/-0.27 of 0 (data -0.04; EMERGENT independence — must come out ~0 WITHOUT imposing it)
R_HRS median = 2.045e8 Ohm; CV ~46%; log(R_HRS) passes Shapiro (lognormal SHAPE emergent); sigma_lnR_HRS = 0.521 (width calibrated)
R_LRS median = 2.939e5 Ohm; CV ~28.7%; sigma_lnR_LRS ~0.285. MUST use SERIES transistor set (gives 3.24e5); FAIL if branch set used (gives 7.6e4)
I_cc mean = 5.146e-5 A; CV(I_cc) = 1.0% EMERGENT from transistor decoupling (must come out ~1% with icc_noise=0.01 and NOT be contaminated by ensemble randomness)
Endurance: V_set drift +8.5 mV/cycle (Kendall tau~+0.44); R_HRS tau~-0.28; R_LRS tau~+0.27; V_reset NO significant drift
Progressive (non-abrupt) transitions: phibar(V) is a smooth sigmoid, not a step (visual + finite slope check)
N=1 / K=1 deterministic limit reduces to the v0.1 mean-field I-V curve (continuity gate)
Numerical: no sinh overflow (alpha*V_h clipped); phi stays in [0,1] across all steps; brentq never fails; full 53-cycle single-cell MC runs in < a few seconds

HONESTY AUDIT: documentation explicitly states 25% switching CV and 0.52 sigma_lnR WIDTH are CALIBRATED inputs, and only I_cc-CV-1%, lognormal-SHAPE, independence, and progressive-transition are labelled emergent — no 'finite-N makes it emerge' claim survives
risks: "(1) THE central risk, flagged by all three judges and re-verified by me this session: do NOT regress to claiming 25% CV(V_set) or sigma_lnR=0.52 'emerge from finite-N counting' — the order statistic self-averages (CV 5.4%/2.2%/1.2% at N=50/300/1000) and area-summing shrinks sigma_lnR by ~sqrt(N). These are CALIBRATED inputs via the per-cycle Weibull threshold and per-patch sigma_lnG. The model's legitimate emergences are I_cc CV~1%, lognormal SHAPE, V_set/V_reset independence, and progressive transitions — claim only those. (2) TRANSISTOR-SET TRAP: three of the four candidate proposals cite the WRONG transistor params (22.3uA/1.77/0.26, the M2 branch-SHAPE fit) which gives R_LRS@0.2V=76kOhm, 4x below the measured 290kOhm. Both sets hit I_cc=51uA at apex so the apex alone cannot catch the error — the 0.2V read does. Use the SERIES-divider set (0.37uA/0.759/27.4) and verify R_LRS arithmetically before trusting any sweep. (3) Sharp-vs-progressive tension: thermal positive feedback sharpens SET, but the data demand a progressive (gradual) transition; keep beta moderate and rely on the K-population threshold spread for gradualness, and do NOT try to get noise gain from a razor-thin sigmoid (mutually exclusive with progressive). (4) C2C-vs-D2D identifiability is under-determined by ONE cell (53 cycles): the split between frozen disorder (D2D) and per-cycle threshold (C2C) cannot be uniquely pinned without multi-cell data; document this and treat the single-cell fit as C2C-dominant. (5) K, eta-spread, sigma_lnG are mildly degenerate in setting CVs; mitigate with the strict ordered calibration (each target pinned once). (6) Thermal (Rth, Tmax, Ea split) and the kinetic time-axis (t_SET/t_RESET) are not pinned by single-temperature quasi-static sweeps — they are documented assumptions until variable-T and pulse data are added. (7) Endurance drift (R5) is a phenomenological damage accumulator, not a microscopic defect-generation model. (8) The Bruggeman Theta(phi) is a closed-form mean-field surrogate, not a true Kirchhoff percolation solve; keep p_perc=0 (linear) by default and only enable the percolation knee if future area-scaling data justify it."
